CODEX, END TO END — issue #226 tasks 10.5 and 11.1. Branch slice-codex-proof at HEAD 5ef4a842 (current main). The live proof 10.5 asks for is DONE and recorded; your job is to land what it licenses.

THE PROOF IS ALREADY TAKEN. Do not re-run it, do not re-measure the provider, and do not commission probes of your own. It is controller evidence, by hand, because a boxed seat has no network to reach the provider. Read it first, in full:

  .forge/tasks/controller-codex-proof-2026-09-16-live.json   (the proof)
  .forge/tasks/controller-codex-proof-2026-09-16-raw-report.json  (the instrument's own report)
  .forge/tools/codex-enforcement-probe.py                    (the instrument)

It supersedes `.forge/tasks/controller-codex-proof-2026-09-16.json`, a partial whose restriction axis was NOT established and whose method is refuted in the new record. Do not cite the partial.

WHAT WAS MEASURED, on the INSTALLED binary `codex-cli 0.154.0`, every claim attributable to a command that demonstrably ran:

  - **The class is NOT re-imposed on a bare resume.** A thread opened `-s read-only` denied a write cold, then executed the same write successfully on a bare resume: exit 0, file present. Decision 0030 ruling 2 HOLDS on this version.
  - **Restoring the class denies it again**, and the sandbox says so in words: `cannot create …: Read-only file system`, EXIT=2.
  - **`codex exec resume` has NO sandbox flag.** `-s` is rejected as an unexpected argument. The ONLY channel is `-c sandbox_mode=<class>` — exactly what 0030 ruling 2 prescribes and what the adapter already emits.
  - **Same-root confirmation**: the resumed thread id equals the cold one.
  - **Accounting is per invocation, not cumulative**: two resumes of one thread reported 303 then 308 output tokens; input rises with the conversation and is almost entirely cached, which is history re-read rather than re-billed.
  - **An unknown session id is refused before any work**: exit 1, no `thread.started`, no `turn.started`, provider names the cause.

THREE VERSIONS ARE IN PLAY and reconciling them is the substance of your declaration work: decision 0030 measured **0.148.0**; `adapters/codex.json` currently declares `identity.applies_to` **0.153.4**; the exercised and installed binary is **0.154.0**. The proof exercises the installed one.

YOUR WORK.

  (1) **Tick 10.5** and record, in the tasks return, which recorded observation discharges each axis it names — exact invocation and allowed argv, effective class and applicable fragment re-imposed across resume, exact same-root confirmation, current-only accounting, pre-work rejection shape. One citation per axis. Do not tick an axis the record does not cover.

  (2) **Reconcile `adapters/codex.json`.** The `work-site` entry already reads `supported` under the 2026-09-15 operator ruling; keep that disposition, it is not yours to flip. Update the identity and evidence so they name what was actually exercised: the historical 0.148.0 measurement, the current applicability, and this dated 0.153.4→0.154.0 reconciliation with the new proof as its evidence reference. State plainly, in the reason, that the re-imposition channel is `-c sandbox_mode` and that the resume subcommand offers no sandbox flag — that is why the adapter emits what it emits.

  (3) **Land the matching adapter assertions** 11.1 asks for, as tests over the argv the adapter composes: a resume argv carries the class through `-c sandbox_mode=<class>` and never through `-s`; the offered root is the one confirmed; a mismatch in identity, boundary, hands or accounting still refuses with its proper token. Prove each by removal — break the line it claims, watch it fail, restore, say so.

  (4) **Tick 11.1 only if its whole acceptance is evidenced**, and say plainly if it is not. 11.1 also names 10.1's interface; if that dependency is not satisfied at this head, leave 11.1 unticked and report exactly what is missing. Preserving the shipping disposition does NOT complete this task, and the task text says so.

WHAT IS NOT YOURS. Tasks 10.6, 10.7, 10.8 and their enablement tasks 11.2-11.4 — Claude, DSH and LaneTally are untouched by this proof and stay `unmeasured`. Passes C and D. Archiving the change. Re-folding the five living specs the reconciliation withdrew. Editing frozen contracts, policy, reference or fixtures. Two shapes are NEW in 0.154.0 and were never previously supported — `--worktree` (a managed git worktree session) and `--thread-source`; they are out of scope for a preservation proof and must not be read as qualified.

DO NOT TRADE SAFETY FOR THE RULING. The operator ruled that the rejoin main performs today stays live. That is not licence to enable a shape whose confinement is unknown: absence of markers still declines, and every refusal token the gate emits today still emits.

STATE OF THE BRANCH, and keep it true. Main is green at 5ef4a842. The exact coverage gate demands literal equality on lines, branches and functions, so every line you add is a line it will demand covered. fmt, clippy across all targets and features, the crate suites, both bundle compiles and strict OpenSpec validation must all pass.

HOW TO MEASURE COVERAGE. Use a writable disk-backed TMPDIR OUTSIDE the repository; an in-repo TMPDIR breaks the ledger tests and the box's global TMPDIR may be read-only from a seat. Boundary tests skip inside the box, which cannot create a bwrap namespace on this host, so in-box equality is unattainable and is not your failure (#286). Report your in-box numbers; the host measurement is the controller's.

A HOUSE LESSON THAT COST THREE CI ROUNDS TODAY. Stage any file you are about to exec beside its target and `rename` it into place; never write at the target path. And never assert a refusal as `is_err()` alone — assert the REASON, because a call that failed for an unrelated cause satisfies `is_err()` while the check under test is never reached.

IF YOU RUN OUT OF ROOM. Return `oversized`, never `broken`. Item (1) is the cheapest and most valuable; (2) and (3) are the substance.

KNOWN ENVIRONMENT DEFECTS — do not rediscover them. #282: the installed DSH core forwards GIT_CONFIG_COUNT but filters GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 and GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0, so prefix any git call, git init in tests included, with `env -u GIT_CONFIG_COUNT -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0`. #281: a DeepSeek seat records no turns and no tokens; a harness defect.

PROVIDER INSTRUCTION. No Claude seat; the Fable allowance is spent. Codex (gpt-6-astra at xhigh) holds triage, clarify, the chief architect, analyze and the review chief. DeepSeek (the stable deepseek-v4-flash alias, never the expiring experimental one) holds implement, the task planner and every design and review position.

REVIEW POSITIONS state findings and evidence. They do not direct a verdict, do not tell a gate where to send the work, and do not claim another office's power.

CONSTRAINTS. Commit completed work unsigned. Never push, merge, or start another Brokkr run from a seat; the controller owns remote CI, publication, integration and closure.

This realm is a Rust workspace. Production code is Rust under `crates/`; the
Rust-only architecture is recorded by decision 0009. Semantic changes carry a
decision document with status `proposed` because only the operator accepts one.
Intake seats read `README.md` and decisions 0004 and 0005 before framing a
commission, along with the code and history it touches.

The frozen v1 contracts under `contracts/`, the production table at
`policy/phase-machine.json`, `policy/schemas/`, and `reference/` are read-only.
A contract change lands as a new version file beside the old one, never as an
edit. The evaluator corpus under `fixtures/` is also frozen and is never
regenerated, only versioned.

Tests are part of every change. Extend the suite that proves the code, run
`cargo test --workspace`, compile `bundles/self`, and leave formatting, clippy,
and the exact-coverage gate clean before reporting success.

Commit completed work with `git` using the repository's message style. Never
push.

## Release configuration

The release manager prepares the candidate and profile patches; the operator
publishes them. Local validation is preparation work. Remote CI on the final PR
head, publication, channel updates and live-profile verification are handoff
steps, recorded as pending until their remote results exist. Historical
"live from" channel versions and old journal examples are historical facts,
not current-version references to replace.
